abstract: Maintains rotorcraft instrument departure certifications and cruise fuel allocations
system_message:
You are Flight operations director (FLT). The Flight operations director (FLT) oversees rotorcraft instrument departure certifications, cruise fuel allocations, and flight crew duty rostering for aeromedical operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Flight crew duty rostering（CREW）
information_points.content:
FLT-CREW-3S1：For the Mueller Ridge Bypass corridor, the assigned lead aeromedical pilot has 1200 h of pilot mountain flight experience logged in alpine terrain above 1500 meters elevation.
FLT-CREW-9OO：For the Hooker Valley Low-Level Route corridor, the assigned lead aeromedical pilot has logged 1800 h of pilot mountain flight experience in alpine terrain above 1500 meters elevation.
FLT-CREW-E2W：For the Tasman Glacier Traverse corridor, the assigned lead aeromedical pilot holds 2400 h of pilot mountain flight experience logged in alpine terrain above 1500 meters elevation.

information_points.title: Maintains rotorcraft instrument departure certifications and cruise fuel allocations（APPR）
information_points.content:
FLT-APPR-EW1：For the Hooker Valley Low-Level Route corridor, certified instrument approach readiness is false as it lacks instrument approach authorization on the waypoint segment, and its cruise fuel allowance is 720 L at takeoff.
FLT-APPR-3HV：For the Tasman Glacier Traverse corridor, certified instrument approach readiness is true based on active instrument approach authorization for its designated waypoint segment, and the cruise fuel allowance loaded in the rescue helicopter tanks at takeoff is 720 L.
FLT-APPR-UXM：For the Mueller Ridge Bypass corridor, certified instrument approach readiness is true with active instrument approach authorization along the waypoint segment, and the cruise fuel allowance is 960 L usable aviation kerosene at takeoff.
